intro.data: Two different routes through the machines can reach the same result. Build a second route that behaves like the first.
intro.alchemy: Two different routes through the apparatuses can reach the same result. Build a second route that behaves like the first.
intro.spellcraft: Two different routes through the runes can reach the same result. Build a second route that behaves like the first.
intro.abstract: Two different paths can reach the same result. Build a second path that behaves like the first.

goal.data: Given one path, build another with the same start and end that behaves the same, then reveal the commutative diagram.
goal.alchemy: Given one path, build another with the same start and end that behaves the same, then reveal the commutative diagram.
goal.spellcraft: Given one path, build another with the same start and end that behaves the same, then reveal the commutative diagram.
goal.abstract: Given one path, build another with the same start and end so that g ∘ f = k ∘ h.
